direction_summaries.explanation: This neuron fires on the “headline” or “topic” token in a span—i.e. the single content word (often a noun, proper name, acronym or key technical term) that names what the sentence, title or section is about. Examples include the main subject of a paper (ostomies, stents, cardiac recovery, vasopressin, GIST), a named entity or title (Hounds, Shade, Hareem Shah, Lido degli Estensi, Business Insider), Greek letters (β), counters or labels (篇, 枚, 回答), numerals (10), etc.
